summary: Exmouth Airport (EXM/YEXM) is a small regional airport serving the town of Exmouth on the North West Cape of Western Australia. It functions primarily as a gateway for tourists visiting the nearby Ningaloo Reef and Cape Range National Park, with flights connecting to Perth. The airport handles a modest volume of regional traffic and supports the area's tourism-dependent economy.
faqs:
Q: What airlines operate from Exmouth Airport?
A: Exmouth Airport is primarily served by regional carriers offering scheduled flights to Perth. Charter services and private aviation also use the facility, particularly during peak tourism season.

Q: How far is Exmouth Airport from the town centre?
A: The airport is located a short drive from Exmouth township, typically around 10-15 minutes by car depending on your accommodation location.

Q: Is there public transport available to and from the airport?
A: Public transport options are limited at this regional airport. Most travellers rely on rental cars, pre-arranged shuttle services, or hotel transfers for ground transportation.

Q: What facilities are available at the terminal?
A: As a small regional airport, facilities are basic, typically including a small terminal building, parking, and limited amenities. Travellers should arrange any special needs in advance.
transport_tips: Renting a car is the most practical option for reaching Exmouth from the airport, as the region has limited public transport and many attractions are spread out. Booking a rental vehicle in advance is highly recommended, especially during the dry season (April to October) when tourism peaks. Some local accommodations and tour operators also offer airport pickup services worth arranging ahead of time.
local_tip: If visiting between March and August, time your arrival to coincide with Ningaloo Reef's whale shark season, and book reef tours well in advance as flights and accommodation fill quickly during this peak period.
